name: Stonechild
sourceDistinctions: Full ancestry has two racial Hit Dice and level adjustment +4. A first class level gives ECL 7.
The optional six-level monster class incorporates that level adjustment. There is one racial Hit Die at level 3 and a second at level 4.
Magic Stone is caster level 3 for the full ancestry and each monster-class stage that provides it.
The encounter cards use the core spell’s printed damage. The separate Mayhem & Madness pregen adds Strength to its thrown stones.
Miniatures Handbook pp. 71–72 gives a separate earlier CR 3 monster block. The staged builds are original.
portraitForm: Miren Slatefold, an original Stonechild Fighter
